entries.reason: `IF WS-PTR-X = X'FF000000'` ELSE (PRESENT) arm: NONE-PARA is reached only by transaction mode N, which the crucible starts with no COMMAREA (EIBCALEN 0), and ADDRESS COMMAREA then returns IBM's X'FF000000' on every run. A COMMAREA is present only through the LINK path (LINK-PARA), which does not run NONE-PARA. The harness also refuses a COMMAREA length with no COMMAREA, so no scenario input changes it.

`IF VE-TRNID = EIBTRNID AND VE-TRMID = EIBTRMID AND VE-TASKN = EIBTASKN AND VE-TIME = EIBTIME AND VE-DATE = EIBDATE` ELSE arm: LS-EIB is based on the pointer ADDRESS EIB returns (SET ADDRESS OF LS-EIB TO WS-PTR), i.e. the task's own EIB storage with the same field order and lengths (EIBTIME, EIBDATE, EIBTRNID, EIBTASKN, EIBTRMID), so each VE- field is the EIB field it is compared with and the AND is true on every run. No scenario input changes it.
